body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary Slowed Condition on the target until the start of your next turn; it reduces its next incoming Fire Damage by 2 during that time.

surges.html: Also suppress one ordinary Burning Condition for the same duration.

rider.title: Water Thread
rider.html: Gain a Water Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: suppress one ordinary Movement penalty on yourself or one willing target of that card until the start of your next turn.
